div.p: Concept bike based on combustion engine

This is a bike i designed as a challenge to bring my design concept to a 3D model and visuals, including a custom chassis. The initial idea started from a paper sketch and later tuned into the design you see here. Initital Design started in Fusion 360 and half the work was done in blender. The given designs for the whole bike with individual parts is available in parametric formats. This bike is currently a concept only and no prototyping has been done.
designing the chassis in Fusion 360 (after finalizing the concept sketch)
Assembly of chassis and other mechanical parts.*some parts like engine, rake and wheels were acquired from grabcad
body panel designing was done in blender. The produced panel designs are CAD ready and can be exported as step files for production or other iterations.
.step of the panel designs imported back to Fusion 360
